title: Shortest-Path Multiplicity Heterogeneity as a Graph Diagnostic for Radial Organization in Sampled Geometries
summary: Shortest-path counts describe how many minimal routes connect a pair of graph vertices, complementing distance alone. We study their heterogeneity within graph-distance shells using C_log(p, r_g), the cube root of the third absolute central moment of log shortest-path multiplicities. This permutation-invariant statistic measures variation across shell targets and does not encode direction by itself.
